claim: 各候选硬件BF16 Prefill理论耗时：RTX 4090 (82.6 TFLOPS) ≈ 2.81e15 / 82.6e12 ≈ 34.0s; A100 80GB (312 TFLOPS) ≈ 9.0s; H100 80GB (989 TFLOPS) ≈ 2.84s; M3 Ultra (假设~30 TFLOPS BF16 [待核验]) ≈ 93.7s。
